title: dianthus caryophyllus subsp. longicaulis
intro: Dianthus caryophyllus subsp. longicaulis, commonly known as the long-stemmed carnation, is a subspecies of the carnation plant that belongs to the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, wound healing, and as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus caryophyllus subsp. longicaulis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as geraniol and linalool, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
